race.comment: TEXTURE (3) was having his first run for the new yard and immediately got off the mark with a determined win. Will be even better for it and can measure up again. OCEAN'S JEN (8) got back and ran on hard for a close-up fourth here last time. Course and distance winner and expected to go close. EASY RED (6) will find this easier than last start when he finished 11th over 1600m at this track. That effort came on the back of a win two back at this track. Worth including in this easier race. ITWASONLYAKISS (1) ran a better race last start when he made late ground to finish a close second over 1300m at this track. Looks well placed so expect another big run. PRESS EXPRESS (10) has a low draw and is worth including.
